title_as_printed: Dew Point Conditions for the Synthetic CO2 Mixture at the 31, 35, 40, and 50 C Isotherms

footnotes_as_printed.*: A dew point does not exist at this temperature, pressure, and water content in the pure CO2-water binary system.

pressure_note: dew point pressure P_dew read from the pressure transducer on the chip; absolute/gauge not stated; P_prep is the pump pressure at sample preparation (75 C), not an equilibrium datum

value.what: prepared (gravimetric/volumetric) water mole fraction of the single-phase gas; the dew pressure P_dew is the measured quantity at this composition

extra_unmapped: T_prep C and P_prep MPa (sample preparation conditions)
% change (relative increase of mixture dew pressure over the pure-CO2 value, calculated by authors)
the other P column of this table (mapped in the companion group file)
conversion_needs: rows with printed N/A in the mapped pressure column have no measured dew point (no dew point exists / not available); kept with the N/A text, value of P empty for the builder
notes: One printed table, written twice (table_1_group1: pure CO2 + water, P_pure column; table_1_group2: CO2 + 2.5% N2 + 5.8% O2 + water, mixture column). Rows are identical in both CSVs. Rows 7,8,9 are two exact replicates (rows 8 and 9) plus a close row 7 at the same y. Row 0 N/A carries footnote *.
